name: Conrad Punta de Mita

address.street: Carr. Federal la Cruz de Huanacaxtle - Punta de Mita

insider_take: This ultra-luxe beachfront sanctuary sits on the exclusive Punta Mita peninsula, where the Pacific meets the Sierra Madre mountains in pure Mexican paradise.
whats_special: Conrad Punta de Mita is the only luxury resort with direct access to both Bahía de Banderas and the renowned Punta Mita Golf Club. The property features dramatic clifftop suites with infinity pools that seem to spill into the ocean, plus Mexico's first Conrad resort experience with authentic Nayarit cultural touches.
pro_tip: Book a suite on the northern side for unobstructed sunset views over the Marietas Islands, and time your stay during humpback whale season (December-March) for incredible whale watching right from your terrace.
dont_miss: The hidden Playa de Amor (Love Beach) inside the Marietas Islands National Park - accessible only by swimming through an underwater tunnel. Also, the property's tequila and mezcal tastings featuring rare spirits from local Jalisco distilleries that you can't find anywhere else.
pros: Prime beachfront location on pristine Punta de Mita coastline
Luxurious accommodations with ocean views and premium amenities
Multiple gourmet dining venues featuring local and international cuisine
cons: Remote location requires travel planning for off-property activities
